topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic and sets expectations regarding complement complexity.

topics.label: Fundamentals of the complement system
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the foundational concepts, nomenclature rules, and central molecular role of C3 in the complement system.

topics.label: Complement activation pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the three pathways that initiate complement activation and converge on the threshold of C3 convertase formation.

topics.label: Complement effector mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the downstream mechanisms by which activated complement eliminates pathogens and stimulates inflammation.

topics.label: Regulation of complement and host protection
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how regulatory proteins prevent the complement cascade from damaging healthy host tissues.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the distinct clinical presentations and infection risks associated with deficiencies in specific complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how pathogens, particularly Staphylococcus aureus, circumvent complement-mediated immune clearance.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming topic on the adaptive immune system.
